clips.title: The story
paras: Theldurin the Lost is a reclusive, half-mad dwarf wandering the scorched expanses of the Badlands. Formerly aligned with the insidious Twilight's Hammer cult, he fled their ranks with stolen sacred relics after realizing the horror of their designs.

Perched in the barren hills of the Badlands, clutching bags of explosives in wild paranoia, Theldurin is far more than a simple mad hermit. He was once an initiate of the Twilight's Hammer cult. When the sinister cabal sought to awaken a primordial elemental power trapped beneath the earth, Theldurin recoiled in terror, rejected their mad teachings, and fled into the desert. He carried with him the Scroll of Myzrael, desperate to prevent his former masters from unleashing an ancient horror upon the world. Though the escape cost him his sanity, his defiance dealt a serious blow to the cult's plans.
